expert.quote_1: When a woman is preparing for pregnancy or recovering after childbirth, we often see the same issues: iron deficiency and its consequences, insufficient protein intake and absorption, and shortfalls in the vitamins needed to build healthy blood. Ketology is an excellent way to effectively address additional protein intake with a complete set of amino acids, as well as an additional source of B vitamins to help prevent deficiency.
